description: What changed on-chain for the top 1000 tokens in the last month, newest first: unlocks within a week that the market can’t absorb (unlock), contract owners gaining powers or handing the contract on (admin), large holders sending to or taking from exchange addresses, or locked tokens reaching wallets (whale), pool liquidity falling 30%+ (drain), new dangerous copies under the ticker with real money in their pools (fake), a home-chain mint its vesting and emission schedule doesn’t cover (mint), a bridged copy losing its backing or supply growing on another chain with no mint at home (bridge), and an exchange announcing it lists or delists the token, spot or perpetuals (listing: OKX, Bybit, KuCoin, Bitget, from their own announcement APIs), an exploit of the token’s protocol with its reported loss (hack, from DeFiHackLabs), and the project’s website going dark or its domain parked (site). Each money signal is sized against 2% order-book depth and a day of trading volume. Filter by kind or by token. Use when someone asks what is happening with a token, about whale moves, upcoming unlocks, or risks to watch.

kind.description: Only this kind: unlock, mint, bridge, admin, whale, drain, fake, hack, listing, site

lang.description: Language of the text answer: en or ru
